purpose: Compact navigation projection for ChatGPT. Exact legal handles remain authoritative in matching CURRENT AUTHORING_HANDLES.json. Technically eligible simple Sprite Animation clips may be selected directly by animationHandle without Actor-prefab ownership.

schemaClosedEnums.instruction: Closed-world fields: copy one of these exact literals. Never invent, alias or substitute semantic synonyms.

authoringSemantics.authoredPathEvidence: pathPoints are first-class motion evidence. An unambiguous authored path may establish travel direction without duplicating travelDirection metadata.
authoringSemantics.frameEntryExit: A path that starts outside normalized screen space and ends inside satisfies enter; a path that starts inside and ends outside satisfies exit.
authoringSemantics.phaseContinuity: For multi-phase MOVES, continuity and settle/hold checks use authored path endpoints, not only each shot's initial visible coordinates.
authoringSemantics.generatedDialogueTiming: Generated dialogue voice is backend-time-fitted to the authored dialogue window using the same text, character voice and profile, up to the supported 2.0x speech speed. Do not guess future WAV duration or rewrite dialogue merely to pre-fit TTS.
authoringSemantics.moveEditorialGrammar: Use locomotion/choreography MOVES for spatial action and dramaticEditorial/associativeEditorial MOVES for reveal, reaction, target, discovery, standoff and cause/effect moments. Choreography alone is not a substitute for editorial dramatic beats.
authoringSemantics.authoredMovePhasePreservation: When a legal MOVE is authored as its full published phase count with explicit camera, visible composition and actions/dialogue, Unity preserves those authored phases instead of flattening them to a fallback visual-plan template.
authoringSemantics.shotRhythm: Prefer motivated contrast: establish geography, isolate the important subject or target, then return, push, reveal or react for payoff. Repeated wide/hold centered coverage is appropriate only when the MOVE signature deliberately calls for restraint.

startHere: Search this compact starter by intent and use exact legal handles.
Open categoryChunks only when the starter has no suitable choice; open AUTHORING_HANDLES.json only for full evidence.
Choose direct animations by animationHandle; use animationRetrievalPath for phase, source and preview evidence.
Treat authored pathPoints as canonical motion evidence for direction, frame entry/exit and multi-phase continuity.
Generated dialogue is time-fitted by the backend; author the intended line and legal timing window rather than guessing WAV duration.
For narrative films, mix spatial/choreography MOVES with dramaticEditorial or associativeEditorial MOVES when the story contains discovery, threat, reaction, targeting, standoff or cause/effect.
Preview media is evidence only and must never be serialized as runtime artwork.
Use moves[] as the complete first-class V1 directing vocabulary; author one CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1 object.
